evals.prompt: We are about to update 40,000 customer records from a new mapping table. Dry-run it first.
evals.expected_output: A simulation plan/report that blocks writes, previews affected records, detects unmatched/duplicate mappings, and checks invariants.
assertions: Production writes are explicitly disabled or redirected
Material exceptions such as unmatched or duplicate mappings are checked
The result includes a go/no-go decision basis

evals.prompt: Rename one local scratch file and dry-run it.
evals.expected_output: The skill may judge a full dry-run unnecessary because the action is low risk and easily reversible.
assertions: The skill does not impose heavy ceremony on a trivial reversible action

evals.prompt: Test the notification workflow but do not contact real customers.
evals.expected_output: Messages are redirected/captured and recipients/content are previewed without external delivery.
assertions: The predicted recipient set and content are inspectable
